known_consumed_evidence.v5_xlsx_row_289_context: Unprocessed nonfood materials -> Raw cotton -> Coal -> Natural gas -> Crude petroleum
known_consumed_evidence.v5_xlsx_row_527_context: Stage <num> intermediate demand -> Stage <num> intermediate demand goods -> commodity list -> Crude petroleum

layered_result_model.invariant: downstream block, field, release-context, or transport ambiguity must never erase an already proven identity mapping

local_block_policy.header_anchor: nearest local header stack in the same container whose resolved leaf roles contain both a description-header role and an identifier-header role
local_block_policy.header_role_precedence: most-specific recognized child/leaf header wins; a mixed leaf such as Index code remains ambiguous; broader parent/group labels do not override a recognized child role
local_block_policy.merged_header_policy: merged/group header text may provide parent context, but an explicit child header controls the leaf role; unresolved merged structure fails closed without reading economic cells
local_block_policy.data_block_start: row immediately after the local header stack
local_block_policy.data_block_end: row immediately before the next local header stack, otherwise end of container
local_block_policy.role_scope: only the local header stack and rows in its governed local block
local_block_policy.revision_context_scope: contiguous non-data rows immediately above the local header stack, stopping at the first blank separator row or prior local header stack, maximum 5 rows
local_block_policy.candidate_rows: Crude petroleum rows inside the local block whose identifier cell normalizes to 0561 under a proven local identifier header
local_block_policy.numeric_economic_cells: must not be parsed or returned

identifier_normalization_policy.prerequisite: identifier column must already be proven from non-economic local header semantics

transport_policy.dns_failure: transport_status=failed; semantic_status=not_evaluated; emit transport_dns_failure only; do not infer content ambiguity
transport_policy.http_401_403_429_or_challenge: transport_status=failed; semantic_status=not_evaluated; emit http_access_control only; no retry

allowed_persistent_output_if_future_appr: transport status and non-content transport reason code
exact non-economic header text and header path
revision-context labels scoped to the local title/header region
yes/no whether local scoping removes whole-container ambiguity
numeric-redacted non-economic text cells around Crude petroleum occurrences
recognized header role or null for each persisted text cell
next_gate: owner_methodology_decision_required_before_any_change_to_fixed_2026_BLS_resource_boundary; no further live request is justified under current fixed-resource v9 design

execution_environment_policy.rationale: prior protected GitHub Actions BLS preflights completed HTTP retrieval while the later local runtime encountered DNS resolution failure; future live execution should use the auditable environment with demonstrated BLS reachability
execution_environment_policy.github_write_unavailable_behavior: fail_closed_before_network; do not bypass to direct local execution under the same authorization; obtain a new explicit owner authorization after the protected write path is restored

independent_resource_attempt_policy.dns_or_name_resolution_failure: record transport_dns_failure and semantic_status=not_evaluated for that resource; do not retry it; the other fixed resource retains its one separately authorized attempt
independent_resource_attempt_policy.http_401_403_429_or_challenge: global stop; do not retry and do not attempt any remaining resource
independent_resource_attempt_policy.redirect: global stop; do not follow and do not attempt any remaining resource
independent_resource_attempt_policy.other_non_200: global stop; do not retry and do not attempt any remaining resource

execution_environment_policy.mandatory_post_run_consumption: consume the one-off authorization after the run regardless of PASS, AMBIGUOUS, transport failure, or partial two-resource completion

header_compatibility_policy.predecessor_evidence: Issue #244 successfully mapped 0561 while recognizing bare Code as an identifier header term
header_compatibility_policy.substring_only_matches_for_code: forbidden; Code must appear as a standalone word token
header_compatibility_policy.rationale: The completed Issue #258 run returned no_local_header_anchor for both formats. Static parser comparison shows the hardened parser dropped the predecessor's bare Code header recognition, making this the smallest compatibility restoration to test before changing any broader block rules.

candidate_context_inventory_policy.trigger: only when normal local-anchor diagnostics return no_local_header_anchor
candidate_context_inventory_policy.candidate_detection: case-insensitive exact phrase Crude petroleum in text cells; does not require any header anchor
candidate_context_inventory_policy.numeric_token_policy: all standalone numeric tokens are replaced with <num> before persistence
candidate_context_inventory_policy.alphanumeric_numeric_token_policy: tokens containing both letters and digits are replaced with <alnum-redacted> before persistence
candidate_context_inventory_policy.identifier_values: forbidden; this diagnostic does not read or persist identifier values
candidate_context_inventory_policy.output_goal: reveal unknown header vocabulary, header-row distance, or split-row structure causing no_local_header_anchor without exposing numeric data

exact_label_candidate_policy.input: numeric-redacted candidate text persisted by consumed v5 run
exact_label_candidate_policy.purpose: exclude footnote mentions and concept variants such as domestic production, extraction, and pipeline transportation before any identifier or value read

xlsx_context_discriminator_policy.input: at most 8 preceding numeric-redacted rows already persisted by consumed v5 run
xlsx_context_discriminator_policy.decision_rule: A stage/intermediate-demand context is not the preregistered direct-commodity candidate. A direct-commodity marker with no stage marker is the sole preferred structural candidate. Both or neither remain ambiguous.

candidate_local_header_gap_policy.prerequisite_html: exact-label filter yields exactly one HTML candidate
candidate_local_header_gap_policy.prerequisite_xlsx: exact-label filter yields exactly two XLSX candidates and context discriminator yields exactly one commodity_unprocessed_nonfood_context candidate plus one stage_intermediate_demand_context candidate
candidate_local_header_gap_policy.selected_candidates: HTML exact-label survivor and XLSX direct-commodity-context survivor only
persistent_fields: nearest recognized header-role row coordinate and distance
candidate_local_header_gap_policy.numeric_token_policy: same as v5: standalone numeric tokens -> <num>; alphanumeric tokens containing digits -> <alnum-redacted>; numeric-only and placeholder-only cells omitted
stop_conditions: v6 exact-label counts differ from 1 HTML and 2 XLSX
XLSX v6 context classification does not yield exactly one direct-commodity and one stage-demand candidate
selected candidate is chosen by row number instead of semantic rules
more than 32 preceding rows would be inspected
more than 128 text cells would be persisted for either selected candidate
identifier or economic numeric value would be read or persisted
candidate_local_header_gap_policy.output_goal: determine whether the actual governing header row is farther than the v5 8-row window and capture the smallest non-economic vocabulary needed for a later identifier/index-field verification

container_header_band_policy.prerequisite_html: v6 exact-label filter yields exactly one HTML candidate and therefore one selected HTML container
container_header_band_policy.prerequisite_xlsx: v6 exact-label/context discriminator yields exactly one direct-commodity XLSX candidate and therefore one selected XLSX container
container_header_band_policy.selected_containers: the container holding the HTML exact-label survivor and the container holding the XLSX direct-commodity-context survivor
persistent_fields: resource path and selected container identifier
container_header_band_policy.numeric_token_policy: same as v5/v7: standalone numeric tokens -> <num>; alphanumeric tokens containing digits -> <alnum-redacted>; numeric-only and placeholder-only cells omitted
stop_conditions: a selected container is chosen by row number rather than semantic candidate selection
more than 32 top rows would be inspected
more than 128 sanitized text cells would be persisted for either selected container
identifier or economic numeric value would be read or persisted
container_header_band_policy.output_goal: capture the true column-header/title vocabulary near the top of the already selected container so section/group labels can be distinguished from governing column headers

xlsx_2026.selection_basis: v6 exact-label plus direct-commodity semantic context

structural_feasibility_policy.invariant: A target container that lacks a proven index-level field cannot supply an index-level observation, even when target identity is proven elsewhere.
structural_feasibility_policy.no_broadening_rule: Do not broaden from the exact-target/direct-commodity candidate to footnotes, domestic-production variants, extraction variants, pipeline variants, stage-demand variants, or unrelated containers merely to locate an index-level field.
structural_feasibility_policy.alternate_source_rule: No alternate source or dynamic substitution is permitted under the current v2.1F fixed-resource design.
structural_feasibility_policy.identity_rule: Previously proven Crude petroleum -> 0561 identity remains valid and is not erased by the 2026 field-level structural failure.

successor_options.option_a: retain current fixed resources and conclude WPU0561 historical-vintage feasibility fails closed for v2.1F because the 2026 fixed XLSX selected target container has no index-level field
successor_options.option_b: separately redesign the BLS 2026 source/resource boundary, which would be a new methodology decision and cannot be inferred or substituted automatically
successor_options.forbidden_shortcut: search concept variants or alternate sources until an index-level field is found
